newsitem.title: USA: Bob Evans Farms to sell deli-salad company.
newsitem.headline: Bob Evans Farms to sell deli-salad company.

text.p: Bob Evans Farms Inc said Tuesday it had signed a letter of intent to sell substantially all of the assets of its deli-salad company to Horizon Partners Ltd.
Terms of the agreement, involving Mrs. Giles Country Kitchens, were not disclosed.
The deal is subject to final negotiations. It is expected to be closed by January 15, 1997.
Bob Evans said it plans to continue selling salads produced by Mrs. Giles Country Kitchens in grocery stores and in its restaurants.
Bob Evans acquired the salad company in September 1991.
Horizon Partners, which provides equity capital to private companies to finance their growth and to support management buyouts, will operate Mrs. Giles as a stand-alone business.
Bob Evans produces and distributes food products under the names Bob Evans Farms Sausage and Owens Country Sausage. It also owns and operates 381 restaurants in 18 states.
